patch:
diff --git a/django/utils/translation/trans_real.py b/django/utils/translation/trans_real.py
index 7dcc77b46c..cb039e388e 100644
--- a/django/utils/translation/trans_real.py
+++ b/django/utils/translation/trans_real.py
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@ language_code_re = _lazy_re_compile(
     re.IGNORECASE
 )
 
-language_code_prefix_re = _lazy_re_compile(r'^/(\w+([@-]\w+)?)(/|$)')
+language_code_prefix_re = _lazy_re_compile(r'^/(\w+([@-]\w+)*)(/|$)')
 
 
 @receiver(setting_changed)
@@ -509,6 +509,12 @@ def get_language_from_path(path, strict=False):
     if not regex_match:
         return None
     lang_code = regex_match[1]
+    # Language codes with more than two subtags (e.g. "en-latn-us") are only
+    # accepted when they are explicitly listed in LANGUAGES to avoid consuming
+    # the rest of the URL as part of the language prefix (e.g.
+    # "de-simple-page"), see #27063.
+    if lang_code.count('-') > 1 and lang_code not in get_languages():
+        return None
     try:
         return get_supported_language_variant(lang_code, strict=strict)
     except LookupError:
